created_at: the actions row equals the frame actions_source as a whole row, created_at compared as an instant
restatement: per action symbol, for reference and mark separately: current=price(M.price_model_number) (double); for each D event of the symbol in applied-row order: factor = DIVIDEND ? 1+value/raw_close : value; x=Decimal(current/factor); current=x.as_double(); A.price_model_number == x.to_string(), A.price_frame_id == last frame_after; every other instrument field (source_id, source_digest, date, cost_evidence, cost_parameters) equals M

rules.b: A equals M on valuation fields, book/day, policy revision and producer/policy metadata
rules.finalization: F, S decision and anchor identity
rules.input: all eight rows are JSON objects
rules.new_symbol: spec default 6: not held, no event, M single source-id namespace (text before the last /), previous-close dates and one frame
rules.schema: M finalization-only with null model; A accounting v1 bound to P2
rules.seal: M, A, F, anchor and actions row content digests
